description: Reference only. Availability and unused-app preferences must be checked on each TV. This file is never applied automatically.
notes: Do not equate installed with unused. Ask the TV owner which apps to retain.
Retail demo assets may occupy substantial space; verify their role and the owner's backup preference before deletion.
Do not remove Gallery assets, screensaver protection, system partitions, pairing data, or streaming-app caches as a generic cleanup step.
